skills.summary_zh: nf-core WGS/WES 与 ATAC 流程部署和样本表生成
skills.execution_note: The retained scripts detect input types and generate samplesheets. WGS/WES uses nf-core/sarek; ATAC uses nf-core/atacseq. Install Nextflow, its Java runtime, a supported container runtime and pipeline references separately. SRA/GEO downloads require network and SRA tools. Run scripts/check_environment.py and inspect each script --help. Pipeline test profiles and scientific workflows have not been run.
keywords: nf-core WGS/WES 与 ATAC 流程部署和样本表生成

skills.summary_zh: DNA定量、完整性与 qPCR 仪器数据标准化
skills.execution_note: Use scripts/convert_to_asm.py for supported instrument exports and scripts/validate_asm.py for schema checks. DNA scope includes NanoDrop concentration, DNA integrity and QuantStudio/qPCR exports. Install the upstream allotropy parser and format-specific optional dependencies. PDF/Excel support depends on the actual parser; preserving this example skill does not validate every instrument format.
keywords: DNA定量、完整性与 qPCR 仪器数据标准化

skills.summary_zh: PeakVI 单细胞染色质可及性与 MultiVI 多组学建模
skills.execution_note: DNA-relevant entrypoints are PeakVI for scATAC-seq and MultiVI for paired/unpaired RNA+ATAC. The complete upstream skill also contains RNA workflows; those are not counted as separate DNA additions. Install scvi-tools/PyTorch and provide count matrices, feature annotations and a suitable training environment. Training scripts are preserved; no models were trained or accuracy validated.
keywords: PeakVI 单细胞染色质可及性与 MultiVI 多组学建模

skills.summary_zh: AWS HealthOmics 基因组流程迁移与变异分析指南
skills.execution_note: This is a transparent conversion of selected Kiro Markdown skill/steering guides, not an upstream SKILL.md or a bundled MCP implementation. Install the actual official server with `uvx awslabs.aws-healthomics-mcp-server`, configure an AWS profile/region, and inspect its live tools/list before mapping the upstream guide names. Reference: https://awslabs.github.io/mcp/servers/aws-healthomics-mcp-server/ . The AWS CLI exposes `aws omics create-workflow` and `aws omics start-run`. HealthOmics requires your IAM role, S3 input/output and container references; cloud resource creation/runs incur costs. No cloud writes were performed. Local life-sciences-* sample clients are not represented as validated scientific executors.
skills.description: Prepare DNA sequencing and variant workflows for AWS HealthOmics using selected upstream Kiro guidance. Use for WDL/Nextflow import, genomic file-format checks, container references and workflow/run inspection; requires a separately configured official AWS HealthOmics MCP server or AWS CLI.
keywords: AWS HealthOmics 基因组流程迁移与变异分析指南

skills.summary_zh: Galaxy REST 与 BioBlend 的历史、数据集和流程操作
skills.execution_note: This is a transparent SKILL.md entrypoint around the original galaxy.md REST and galaxy-bioblend.md SDK guides. Use `from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance` with the user-selected server. History/dataset/workflow primitives complement the separately packaged galaxy-bridge recommendation CLI. references/original/setup-credentials.sh is retained as an optional manual helper and was not executed. The unrelated gene-mapping-by-log-fold-change material is excluded because numerical expression similarity cannot establish gene identity.
skills.description: Use Galaxy REST or the BioBlend Python SDK to manage genomic analysis histories, upload or inspect datasets, discover tools and invoke existing workflows on a user-selected Galaxy server. Includes the original REST and SDK guides; server tools, account access and scientific workflows are external.
keywords: Galaxy REST 与 BioBlend 的历史、数据集和流程操作

skills.summary_zh: Bioconductor 基因组包发现与 R 工作流模板
skills.execution_note: From this installed folder run `python bioconductor_bridge.py --help`. Domain/workflow templates are available locally; live package discovery/documentation and installation require R/BiocManager/network as indicated. The small original clawbio/common/checksums.py helper is bundled under resources and the script root is adjusted to that portable location. Root `clawbio.py` commands in retained upstream prose require a separate full ClawBio checkout; use the standalone script here.
skills.attribution: Hiranyamaya Dash; Copyright 2026 Manuel Corpas (ClawBio license)
keywords: Bioconductor 基因组包发现与 R 工作流模板

skills.summary_zh: Galaxy 基因组工具检索、推荐与提交
skills.execution_note: From this installed folder run `python galaxy_bridge.py --help`. Offline --search/--recommend/--workflow read the complete bundled catalog and curated tool resources. Actual --run requires a Galaxy account, BioBlend and the user-selected server; tool versions/availability may differ from the snapshot. The bundled demo output is an upstream example, not evidence of a newly executed analysis. Root clawbio.py commands require a full ClawBio checkout.
keywords: Galaxy 基因组工具检索、推荐与提交

skills.summary_zh: UKB-PPP 区域 pQTL 汇总统计获取与统一
skills.execution_note: The module ukb_ppp_region_fetch.py exports UKBPPPClient.fetch_region; inspect --help for the CLI. A SORT1/EUR GRCh38 slice is bundled for offline use. Arbitrary regions use Synapse and need a PAT with access to syn51364943; the public-looking S3 URL can return AccessDenied. Software is MIT (Aviv Madar); bundled summary-statistic derivatives are CC-BY-4.0 with Sun et al. 2023 attribution. Sources: https://registry.opendata.aws/ukbppp/ and https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06592-6 . This is summary-level pQTL data, not individual UK Biobank records.
skills.attribution: Copyright 2026 Aviv Madar; UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, Sun et al. (2023)

data_license.attribution: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (Sun et al. 2023 Nature; PMID 37794186); accessed via Synapse syn51364943.

keywords: UKB-PPP 区域 pQTL 汇总统计获取与统一

skills.summary_zh: RNA 剪接异常作为 DNA 变异功能证据
skills.execution_note: Run the retained examples/fraser2_rare_disease.R only after supplying RNA-seq splice-junction/count data and a matched control panel. Install FRASER/OUTRIDER or DROP as needed. This provides functional evidence for candidate DNA splice variants; abnormal expression/splicing does not by itself establish pathogenicity. No clinical cohort or scientific workflow was run.
keywords: RNA 剪接异常作为 DNA 变异功能证据

skills.summary_zh: 从单细胞 RNA 数据推断染色体拷贝数异常
skills.execution_note: The upstream R examples use inferCNV/copyKAT/Numbat/SCEVAN and need matching counts, genomic feature coordinates and appropriate references. The output is RNA-derived evidence about large-scale DNA copy-number states, not direct DNA measurement or a validated clinical call. Retain normal-reference selection, genomic build and uncertainty in reports.
keywords: 从单细胞 RNA 数据推断染色体拷贝数异常

skills.summary_zh: 1000 Genomes 个体、群体与亲缘查询
skills.execution_note: Distinct increment over population-genetics-1000genomes: query individual genotypes/variants and select variant carriers or compute service-provided pairwise relatedness, beyond the retained IGSR population/sample discovery guide. Use scripts/onekgpd_meta.py for offline sample/population metadata from assets/kgpe.json. scripts/onekgpd_api.py needs the separately installed dnaerys client and queries the public db.dnaerys.org:443 service. Only public 1000 Genomes cohort identifiers are accepted; no patient data are needed. The MIT skill and metadata do not redistribute or relicense the proprietary Dnaerys database engine. Annotation sources/terms remain as described at https://dnaerys.org/online/ .
